13114-the-collectors-being-cases-mostly-.creator: FRANK JEWETT MATHER, Junr.
13114-the-collectors-being-cases-mostly-.description: A book by FRANK JEWETT MATHER, Junr.. From Frisco to the Bosphorus   All sightly stuff, the less the more, We want it in our hoard and store. Nor sacrilege doth us appal-- Egyptian vault--fane at Cawnpore--   Collector folk are sinners all.

arxiv-2107-05512.title: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface-Aided MISO Systems with Statistical CSI: Channel Estimation, Analysis and Optimization (Invited Paper)
arxiv-2107-05512.creator: Kangda Zhi, Cunhua Pan, Hong Ren, Kezhi Wang, Maged Elkashlan
arxiv-2107-05512.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Kangda Zhi, Cunhua Pan, Hong Ren, Kezhi Wang, Maged Elkashlan. This paper investigates the reconfigurable reflecting surface (RIS)-aided multiple-input-single-output (MISO) systems with imperfect channel state information (CSI), where RIS-related channels are modeled by Rician fading. Considering the overhead and complexity in practical systems, we employ the low-complexity maximum ratio combining (MRC) beamforming at the base station (BS), and configure the phase shifts of the RIS based on long-term statistical CSI.

arxiv-2111-01632.title: Elucidating Robust Learning with Uncertainty-Aware Corruption Pattern Estimation Journal: Journal of Pattern Recognition
arxiv-2111-01632.creator: Jeongeun Park, Seungyoun Shin, Sangheum Hwang, Sungjoon Choi
arxiv-2111-01632.description: Abstract Robust learning methods aim to learn a clean target distribution from noisy and corrupted training data where a specific corruption pattern is often assumed a priori. Our proposed method can not only successfully learn the clean target distribution from a dirty dataset but also can estimate the underlying noise pattern.

arxiv-2204-14226.title: Recommendations on test datasets for evaluating AI solutions in pathology
arxiv-2204-14226.creator: André Homeyer, Christian Geißler, Lars Ole Schwen, Falk Zakrzewski, Theodore Evans, Klaus Strohmenger, Max Westphal, Roman David Bülow, Michaela Kargl, Aray Karjauv, Isidre Munné-Bertran, Carl Orge Retzlaff, Adrià Romero-López, Tomasz Sołtysiński, Markus Plass, Rita Carvalho, Peter Steinbach, Yu-Chi
arxiv-2204-14226.description: Abstract Artificial intelligence (AI) solutions that automatically extract information from digital histology images have shown great promise for improving pathological diagnosis. Prior to routine use, it is important to evaluate their predictive performance and obtain regulatory approval. This assessment requires appropriate test datasets. However, compiling such datasets is challenging and specific recommendations are missing.

arxiv-2307-04276.title: Automated Essay Scoring in Argumentative Writing: DeBERTeachingAssistant
arxiv-2307-04276.creator: Yann Hicke, Tonghua Tian, Karan Jha, Choong Hee Kim
arxiv-2307-04276.description: Abstract Automated Essay scoring has been explored as a research and industry problem for over 50 years. It has drawn a lot of attention from the NLP community because of its clear educational value as a research area that can engender the creation of valuable time-saving tools for educators around the world.

arxiv-2309-08362.title: Towards Big Data Modeling and Management Systems: From DB MS to BD MS
arxiv-2309-08362.creator: Rania Mkhinini Gahar, Olfa Arfaoui, Minyar Sassi Hidri
arxiv-2309-08362.description: Abstract To succeed in a Big Data strategy, you have to arm yourself with a wide range of data skills and best practices. This strategy can result in an impressive asset that can streamline operational costs, reduce time to market, and enable the creation of new products.

arxiv-2312-15621.title: On the intertwining differential operators from a line bundle to a vector bundle over the real projective space
arxiv-2312-15621.creator: Toshihisa Kubo, Bent Ørsted
arxiv-2312-15621.description: Abstract . We classify and construct S ​ L ​ ( n , ℝ ) SL(n,\mathbb{R}) -intertwining differential operators 𝒟 \mathcal{D} from a line bundle to a vector bundle over the real projective space ℝℙ n − 1 \mathbb{R}\mathbb{P}^{n-1} by the F-method.

arxiv-2401-03841.title: New theoretical developments on the early-time dynamics and approach to equilibrium in Heavy-Ion collisions
arxiv-2401-03841.creator: \firstname Sören \lastname Schlichting
arxiv-2401-03841.description: Abstract We discuss recent theoretical developments in understanding the early pre-equilibrium dynamics and onset of hydrodynamic behavior in high-energy heavy-ion collisions. We highlight possible experimental signatures of the pre-equilibrium phase, and present recent progress in developing a consistent theoretical description of collective flow in small systems.

arxiv-2402-14684.title: Adaptive Time Series Forecasting with Markovian Variance Switching
arxiv-2402-14684.creator: Baptiste Abélès, Joseph de Vilmarest, Olivier Wintemberger
arxiv-2402-14684.description: Abstract Adaptive time series forecasting is essential for prediction under regime changes. Several classical methods assume linear Gaussian state space model (LGSSM) with variances constant in time. However, there are many real-world processes that cannot be captured by such models. We consider a state-space model with Markov switching variances.

arxiv-2412-16696.title: Shielding of breathers for the focusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation
arxiv-2412-16696.creator: Gregorio Falqui, Tamara Grava, Christian Puntini
arxiv-2412-16696.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Gregorio Falqui, Tamara Grava, Christian Puntini. We study a deterministic gas of breathers for the Focusing Nonlinear Schrödinger equation. The gas of breathers is obtained from a N N -breather solution in the limit N → ∞ N\to\infty . The limit is performed at the level of scattering data by letting the N N -breather spectrum to fill uniformly a suitable compact domain of the complex plane in the limit N → ∞ N\to\infty .

arxiv-2502-17882.title: Science Across Languages: Assessing LLM Multilingual Translation of Scientific Papers
arxiv-2502-17882.creator: Hannah Calzi Kleidermacher kleid@stanford.edu, James Zou jamesz@stanford.edu
arxiv-2502-17882.description: Abstract Scientific research is inherently global. However, the vast majority of academic journals are published exclusively in English, creating barriers for non-native-English-speaking researchers. In this study, we leverage large language models (LLMs) to translate published scientific articles while preserving their native JATS XML formatting, thereby developing a practical, automated approach for implementation by academic journals.

arxiv-2509-07866.title: The Role of Magnetospheric Rebound in Breaking Resonant Chains of Super-Earths and Mini-Neptunes
arxiv-2509-07866.creator: Mengrui Pan, Andre Izidoro, Sho Shibata
arxiv-2509-07866.description: Abstract Stellar magnetic fields are thought to truncate the inner regions of protoplanetary disks around T Tauri stars, creating a magnetospheric cavity near the star. As the disk evolves and disperses, the truncation radius is expected to move outward as the balance between magnetic and viscous forces shifts.

arxiv-2509-15384.title: A high geometric albedo and small size of the Haumea cluster member (24835) 1995 SM 55 {}_{\textrm{55}} from a stellar occultation and photometric observations
arxiv-2509-15384.creator: J. L. Ortiz, N. Morales, B. Sicardy, F. L. Rommel, F. Braga-Ribas, Y. Kilic, E. Fernández-Valenzuela, J. L. Rizos, B. Morgado, L. Catani, M. Kretlow, J. M. Gómez-Limón, J. arxiv-2509-15384.description: Abstract Context. Trans-Neptunian objects (TNOs) are thought to be some of the most ancient and primitive bodies in our solar system. Understanding their basic physical properties is crucial to unraveling their origin and the evolution of the outer solar system beyond Neptune.

arxiv-2601-21238.title: PTQ4ARVG: Post-Training Quantization for AutoRegressive Visual Generation Models
arxiv-2601-21238.creator: Xuewen Liu, Zhikai Li, Jing Zhang, Mengjuan Chen, Qingyi Gu
arxiv-2601-21238.description: Abstract AutoRegressive Visual Generation (ARVG) models retain an architecture compatible with language models, while achieving performance comparable to diffusion-based models. Quantization is commonly employed in neural networks to reduce model size and computational latency. However, applying quantization to ARVG remains largely underexplored, and existing quantization methods fail to generalize effectively to ARVG models.

pmc-10504028.creator: Nicoletta Nandi, Gian Eugenio Tontini, Lucia Scaramella, Andrea Sorge, Tommaso Pessarelli, Matilde Topa, Luca Elli
pmc-10504028.description: ated by electrohydraulic lithotripsy (EHL) with direct peroral cholangioscopy (DPCS) through double-balloon enteroscopy-assisted endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (DBE-ERCP). pmc-10651812.title: Disease Burden of Meningitis Caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae Among Under-Fives in China: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
pmc-10651812.creator: Biying Wang, Wanjing Lin, Chen Qian, Youyi Zhang, Genming Zhao, Weibing Wang, Tao Zhang
pmc-10651812.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). IntroductionStreptococcus pneumoniae is the leading cause of meningitis, with a case fatality of up to about 50%. Children younger than 5 years are at greater risk for pneumococcal meningitis compared with other populations. It is of significant importance to provide a comprehensive understanding of the burden of pneumococcal meningitis among under-fives in the low pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV) coverage period in China.MethodsA systematic review was conducted.

pmc-10735808.title: DYNAMIC IMPACTS OF FAMILY CONFLICT ON ELDER ABUSE AND NEGLECT AMONG ADRD CAREGIVERS
pmc-10735808.creator: Wesley Browning, Jessica Hernandez Chilatra, Mustafa Yildiz, Vicki Winstead, Carolyn Pickering
pmc-10735808.description: Conflict with other family members impacts dementia caregivers’ well-being and stress-appraisals and may also influence their use of elder abuse and neglect (EAN). To test this, we utilized latent class analysis to classify spouse, adult child, grandchild, and nontraditional (step- and in-laws) caregivers (N = 453) based on family conflict levels at baseline.

pmc-10747500.title: Advances in NIR-Responsive Natural Macromolecular Hydrogel Assembly Drugs for Cancer Treatment
pmc-10747500.creator: Chenyu Zhao, Boyue Pan, Tianlin Wang, Huazhe Yang, David Vance, Xiaojia Li, Haiyang Zhao, Xinru Hu, Tianchang Yang, Zihao Chen, Liang Hao, Ting Liu, Yang Wang, Umile Gianfranco Spizzirri
pmc-10747500.description: Cancer is a serious disease with an abnormal proliferation of organ tissues; it is characterized by malignant infiltration and growth that affects human life. Traditional cancer therapies such as resection, radiotherapy and chemotherapy have a low cure rate and often cause irreversible damage to the body.

pmc-11448152.title: Exploring antimicrobial interactions between metal ions and quaternary ammonium compounds toward synergistic metallo-antimicrobial formulations
pmc-11448152.creator: Andrii Lekhan, Raymond J. Turner
pmc-11448152.description: Multi-target antimicrobial agents are considered a viable alternative to target-specific antibiotics, resistance to which emerged as a global threat. Used centuries before the discovery of conventional antibiotics, metal(loid)-based antimicrobials (MBAs), which target multiple biomolecules within the bacterial cell, are regaining research interest. However, there is a significant limiting factor—the balance between cost and efficiency.

pmc-11449160.title: Travelling beyond time: shared brain system for self-projection in the temporal, political and moral domains
pmc-11449160.creator: Amnon Dafni-Merom, Rotem Monsa, Meitar Benbaji, Adi Klein, Shahar Arzy
pmc-11449160.description: Mental time travel (MTT), a cornerstone of human cognition, enables individuals to mentally project themselves into their past or future. It was shown that this self-projection may extend beyond the temporal domain to the spatial and social domains. What about higher cognitive domains? Twenty-eight participants underwent functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) while self-projecting to different political, moral and temporal perspectives.

pmc-12391493.title: ASL reveals regional brain perfusion impairment in neonates with mild hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy
pmc-12391493.creator: Mario Cirillo, Simona Puzone, Alessandro Pasquale De Rosa, Lorenzo Ugga, Elisabetta Caredda, Mario Diplomatico, Massimiliano De Vivo, Maria Agnese Pirozzi, Alessandra D’Amico, Emanuele Miraglia Del Giudice, Fabrizio Esposito, Paolo Montaldo
pmc-12391493.description: There is a lack of neuroimaging data and effective biomarkers in infants with mild hypoxic ischaemic encephalopathy (HIE). Cerebral reperfusion injury has shown potential as marker of neurodevelopmental outcome in moderate and severe HIE. We examined cerebral perfusion by using arterial spin labelling (ASL) in infants with mild HIE and its associations with adverse outcomes.

pmc-12472064.title: Development and Test of a Novel High-Precision Inchworm Piezoelectric Motor
pmc-12472064.creator: Nan Huang, Jiahao Yin, Fuyuan Feng, Lanyu Zhang, Yuheng Luo, Jian Gao, Nathan Jackson
pmc-12472064.description: The inchworm piezoelectric motor, with the advantages of long stroke and high resolution, is ideally suited for precise positioning in wafer-level electron beam inspection systems. However, the large number of piezoelectric actuators and the complex excitation signal sequences significantly increase the complexity of system assembly and temporal control.

pmc-13028527.title: Stress-Associated Phenylpropanoid Metabolism and Nutritional Composition in Wild vs. MeJA-Elicited In Vitro Hypericum perforatum and Portulaca oleracea
pmc-13028527.creator: Gulmira Zhakupova, Assem Sagandyk, Tamara Tultabayeva, Aknur Muldasheva, Kadyrzhan Makangali, Aigerim Akhmetzhanova
pmc-13028527.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objectives: The phenylpropanoid pathway in plants plays a pivotal role in the biosynthesis of secondary metabolites in plants, responding to environmental stresses to enhance protective compounds such as phenolic acids and flavonoids. This study compares the phenolic profiles, vitamins, sugars, and mineral elements of Hypericum perforatum and Portulaca oleracea grown under two contrasting conditions: wild habitats and in vitro cultures on Murashige–Skoog medium supplemented with methyl jasmonate (MeJA, 25–50 µM).

pmc-13599670.title: CHCl·– activates oxygen-containing gases: Uncovering intrinsic reaction nature from a multiscale theoretical investigation
pmc-13599670.creator: Junxi Liang, Jie Gao, Xinjie Wang, Yalu Zhang, Xiaoyan Bai, Nanzhen Yuan, Huiqiong Wu, Yan Shen, Pen Jin, Yanbin Wang, Qiong Su
pmc-13599670.description: SummaryUnderstanding the ionic reactivity of CHCl˙– anions is essential for modeling chemical processes in interstellar media, plasmas, and planetary atmospheres. Using multiscale computational simulations, this work examines the adsorption and reaction behaviors of eight oxygen-containing gases (O2, CO, CO2, NO, N2O, NO2, COS, SO2) on CHCl˙– clusters. Our findings reveal that electrostatic interactions dominate system stabilization over dispersion forces.

uslaw-usc-t49-s1325.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Chapter 13 (Surface Transportation Board); Subchapter II (Administrative). (a) Establishment; Membership.— There is established the Railroad-Shipper Transportation Advisory Council (in this section referred to as the “Council”) to be composed of 19 members, of which 15 members shall be appointed by the Chairman of the Board, after recommendation from rail carriers.
